items.sentence: At the library, she borrowed a book with a hundred pages.
He opened a book and turned to page ten to read the story.
The artist sharpened a pencil before drawing the tree.
Use a pencil for this sketch so you can erase the lines.
She unscrewed the cap of the bottle and drank the water.
The glass bottle has a narrow neck and holds olive oil.

criteria: Six original sentences: two per admitted starter-object sense (book, pencil, bottle)
Exact single English word matching a displayed Thai meaning; spelling recall, not an open-ended use rubric
Distinct context hashes from F06 base and from each other; shown contexts are consumed even when abandoned
One hint is saved before display and permanently changes this probe to guidedPractice
Origin evidence, original sense/set/core/lexical revisions and probe item revision are retained
24 hours is a versioned engineering rule, not an empirically validated learning constant
UTC controls admission; local device time is display only; all delay claims remain timing-unverified
No general CEFR, independent human calibration, learning efficacy or research outcome claim
